decision: Reject the exact BTC ten-second sell-flow absorption long candidate without threshold, horizon, side, or exit retuning. Do not propose or apply a live route. The candidate lost before and after friction in both forward partitions, worsened under latency/slippage stress, remained negative after removing its largest winner, and was worse than the broad control in pseudo-holdout expectancy.

confidence.basis: The source-bound run reproduced the preregistered 128 development events, evaluated 42 complete candidate trades in validation and 42 in pseudo-holdout under all three scenarios, had zero forward capacity or unreconciled-path failures, and produced consistently negative forward economics.
confidence.boundary: This rejects only the exact registered mechanism and 60/60/24h economic contract. It does not prove that every possible BTC long mechanism lacks edge.

control_comparison.interpretation: The absorption predicates improved nominal validation expectancy relative to the broad extreme-sell/uptrend control, but both lost and the relationship reversed materially in pseudo-holdout. This is unstable selection, not support.

causal_attribution.validation: The raw target/stop path was already slightly negative before costs (-$16.50), and approximately $157.31 of fees converted it to -$173.86 net.
causal_attribution.pseudo_holdout: The raw target/stop path was materially negative before costs (-$251.56); approximately $163.24 of fees and $2.97 of funding worsened it to -$417.76 net.
causal_attribution.stress: Two-second latency plus three additional entry bps increased losses in both forward partitions.
causal_attribution.exit_horizon: Every forward candidate resolved at a fixed target or stop; there were no maximum-hold exits, so the loss is not explained by a stale 24-hour fallback.

performance_engineering.required_follow_up: Replace repeated per-event target/stop queries with an equivalence-tested bulk lifecycle query and add partition/arm/scenario progress checkpoints. Preserve this immutable result as the numerical baseline.

limitations_and_falsifiers: Historical midpoint and public-trade stop proxies are not exact Hyperliquid mark price.
Best-bid target crossing does not reconstruct resting maker queue position.
All partitions were opened by prior project research, so multiple-testing risk remains.
A source hash, causal timing, fee, funding, depth, lifecycle, or manifest mismatch invalidates this result until corrected.
Only a materially different preregistered BTC long mechanism with new evidence may reopen BTC long research; nearby threshold or exit retuning of this exact candidate is prohibited.
